settings: beam5; VAD; no previous-text conditioning; no initial prompt
normalized_exact_match_basis: medium.en reproduced all 201 words with zero differences; no difference appeared in both engines.
normalization: Punctuation/case/apostrophe style; gotta/got to and wanna/want to. No omission or paraphrase allowance; contractions required.

single_engine_artifacts_not_counted.note: Spelling of an invented word absent from the model's lexicon. medium.en rendered it correctly.

fixed_from_W4D.why: Unstressed 'them' reduces to /əm/ and was swallowed before the /m/ of 'motos'. Sentence-final 'them' carries stress and survives.

'about them' reduces to 'about’em', acoustically identical to 'about him'; both engines heard 'him'. A listener would too, which would have narrowed the offer to a boy. Stressed 'they' is unambiguous.

perceptual_review: Not performed. ASR supports words, not naturalness or identity acceptance.
